import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    a.sort()
    median_index = n // 2
    print(a[median_index])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
